# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
Three of the guides pick it as best overall. It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, rotates between portrait and landscape, and takes cases up to 3 mm thick. Belkin says the vent slats must be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and horizontal slats work best. There is also a vent/dash version for awkward vents. ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/))

**Fastest and most reliable: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933), $89.99 list**
It supports Qi2 25W and has thermoelectric cooling plus a fan. MountGuys uses it as their daily driver and calls it their best overall pick. The Gadgeteer lists it at a discounted $69.99. Caveats:
- 25W only applies to the iPhone 16 Pro Max, 16 Plus and 17. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get up to 22W, and iPhone 15 and earlier get about 15W.
- It needs a 45W+ USB-C car adapter. The sources disagree on whether one is included: MountGuys and The Gadgeteer say a 60W adapter comes in the box, while the other guides only state the 45W requirement.
- Anker says it is not compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents.

Sources: [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Best value with a cooling fan: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
It is Qi2-certified and has a fan to prevent heat throttling when running maps. It mounts on a vent or the dash. Prices vary by source:
- ESR's own store lists it at $39.99. With code PARTNER18 it comes to about $32.80, and Dealectric says it tested the code on Oct 22. The code expires Dec 31, 2026, and checkout has the final word.
- The Gadgeteer lists it at $35.99 in one place and $18.99 in another, so check the current price.
- Whether a car adapter is included is unclear, and The Gadgeteer says an 18W one isn't. Budget $10–15 for one if needed.

**[Buy the ESR HaloLock CryoBoost at ESR's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)** (affiliate link, which pays Dealectric a commission at no extra cost to you). Details: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)

**Other options**
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, about $39.95:** The Gadgeteer's top pick, with a 95W adapter included. It uses a suction base, and the fan must stay on for 25W. ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/))
- **VICSEED steel-core vent mount (no charging):** A sturdy, simple choice if you don't want a cable. MountGuys picked it from research rather than hands-on testing. ([MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/))

**Which to pick**
- Standard iPhone and a simple setup: Belkin.
- iPhone 16 Pro Max or 17 and you want top speed: Anker or LISEN 25W.
- Hot climate or heavy navigation use: a fan-cooled model (ESR, LISEN or Anker).

I didn't get direct purchase links for the Belkin, Anker or LISEN mounts, so search those exact names at your preferred retailer. Prices change often.
